newsitem.title: USA: Barney's investor deadline extended to August 1.
newsitem.headline: Barney's investor deadline extended to August 1.

text.p: The deadline for selecting an investor in the recapitalization of bankrupt retailer Barney's Inc has been extended by one week, the company, the creditors committee and its former business partner said Friday.
The deadline has been extended to August 1.

In addition, the creditors committee, Barney's Inc and Isetan Co Ltd, its former business partner, have agreed to extend to no later than August 1, the time in which Barney's must sign a definitive investment agreement with an investor, and to file a motion with the court to extend buyer protections to the investor.

In a joint statement, Barney's and the creditors committee said that the Blackstone Group and Peter J. Solomon Co "are in intensive discussions with several potential investors regarding offers submitted on July 7."

"These discussions are ongoing, and the company and the committee believe that taking an additional week to refine the proposals before selecting an offer will produce the most favorable transaction for all of the company's constituents," they said.
Barney's filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization on January 10, 1996.
